title: New Jersey couple report seeing 8-foot tall Bigfoot stepping out in front of their car: 'We know what we saw'
excerpt: A New Jersey couple claims an 8-foot-tall Bigfoot crossed the road in front of their car on a rainy October night. A BFRO investigator deemed them credible witnesses.
content:
Bigfoot Hunter Claims He Found a BODY, Tyrus Investigates | Planet Tyrus

Did Snake the Bigfoot Hunter actually find a Bigfoot body? On this episode of Planet Tyrus, Tyrus sits down with Snake the Bigfoot Hunter, founder of the Bigfoot Research Organization (BRO), for a deep dive into one of the wildest alleged Bigfoot discoveries in recent years. Snake tells Tyrus the story of discovering what he believes to be an 8-foot Bigfoot body in the Adirondacks of New York, recovering and preserving the specimen, and pursuing DNA testing to determine exactly what he found. Snake discusses the DNA results he says point toward Neanderthal and Denisovan ancestry, his experiences attempting to get scientists and universities to examine the evidence, and the controversy that erupted after he took his alleged Bigfoot specimen public.

A New Jersey couple deemed to be credible witnesses by the investigators who met with them say a Bigfoot, roughly 8-feet tall, crossed the road in front of them while they were driving on a rainy Sunday night around 10:30 p.m. in October.

The husband and wife "had a very normal, human reaction to seeing something they didn't believe exists," BFRO investigator Jacob Korbel reported. Following their encounter, they called the NJ State Park Police and the New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection.

Stock image of car driving in the rain on rural road. (Getty Images)

As the wife was driving with her husband and kids, she says she became terrified. The car's high beams had caught a glimpse of a massive figure stepping out in front of their vehicle on what she described as a rural road.

She slowed down and reported that this massive figure stood about 8-feet tall.

"It was bulky, heavily built GIANT frame. It was covered in jet-black fur and it appeared to be soaking wet. Our headlights were reflecting off its fur. I saw enough detail to distinguish human-like hands and unusually long arms," she claims.

"It walked with a slight hunch but moved at fast speed. It didn’t take many steps for it to get across the road. Thing moved fast enough to look like it was gliding without actually gliding. Its arms swung like a human walks but with heavy reach. I asked my husband if he was seeing the same thing I was ... He confirmed that he saw it."

A sign warning of Bigfoot is posted in a forest in Idaho. (Getty)

WITNESS RECOUNTS FOURTH OF JULY WEEKEND BIGFOOT SIGHTING IN CONNECTICUT, SAYS 'THERE WERE NO BOOBS'

The kids were asleep in the backseat at the time and didn’t see a thing. She called her mom and told her what they had just witnessed crossing the road in front of them.

"Before then, I knew almost nothing of a Bigfoot or a Sasquatch," she added to her reported sighting. "I saw this giant creature with my own eyes. We know what we saw. It was definitely about 8 feet tall."

Unfortunately, they weren’t able to snap a picture of this creature. And investigators credited the heavy rain in Southern New Jersey this fall for washing away any evidence that might have been left behind.

Former rodeo rider Roger Patterson said pictures show the American version of the Abominable Snowman, estimated at 7 1/2 feet tall, taken northeast of Eureka, Calif. (Bettmann Archive)

That said, they did locate a well-used game trail on both sides of the road. Did these two see a Bigfoot or was it another enormous animal who walks like a human?

Let me know what you think. Did they see a Bigfoot? Or send me your own Bigfoot story: sean.joseph@outkick.com.
